messages:
claire: Quick sync  opening a small PR to tidy errref entries for 429s/timeouts. Found a couple of stale links and no Rust snippet for backoff handling. Planning to add consolidated examples and a short migration note for Dedicated/private endpoints.

doc-bot: Link scan: 4 broken anchors under /errref; 2 snippet files missing validate markers. Expect CI label requirement `docs:snippets-changed`. Full log: /tmp/errref-5201.log

ben: I can add a compact Rust example using reqwest and tokio showing Retry-After parsing + exponential jitter. Prefer showing context-like cancellation with timeout via tokio::time::timeout.

nora: Also add a JVM/Java snippet (OkHttp)  some enterprise customers ask for Java examples. Keep both snippets <30 lines so snippets validator stays happy.

sam: Please include a small note about client-side quota windows: if you get repeated 429s, your client might be hitting a short-rate window rather than sustained quota. Recommend backing off with Retry-After and avoid immediate aggressive retries.

ben: Draft Rust pseudo-snippet I'll include:
```rust
let res = client.post(url).bearer_auth(key).json(&body).send().await?;
if res.status() == 429 {
  let ra = res.headers().get("retry-after").and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok()).and_then(|s| s.parse::<u64>().ok()).unwrap_or(1);
  tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_secs(ra) + jitter()).await;
}
```
I'll push full snippet with timeout wrapper and tiny prompt-trim helper.

nora: For Java, show how to read Retry-After and schedule a scheduledExecutor backoff. Also add a short sentence: do not retry on 401/403.

sam: Add a minimal smoke test that asserts a 429 response includes Retry-After and logs the header. That makes it easier for snippets:validate to pass and for QA to repro. Also add the PR checklist: update snippets, run link-checker, run snippets:validate, attach smoke log, request eng/docs review.

claire: Great. I'll open the PR in ~20m, tag @ben @nora @sam, attach the checklist and smoke test output, and add the `docs:snippets-changed` label. Thanks all.
